components.name: Alert.Actions
components.description: A wrapping row of buttons or links under the text.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons or links.

components.name: Alert.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root at the end of the first row. The alert has no open state, so remove it in onClick.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Got it", names the button by itself. Otherwise the dismiss string from StringsProvider names it, Dismiss in English.
props.default: "Dismiss" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Hide the alert here.

components.name: Alert.Description
components.description: Detail under the title. A div element, so it can hold paragraphs or a list.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Alert.Icon
components.description: Slot for any icon, placed before the text. aria-hidden by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic from your own icon set.

components.name: Alert.Root
components.description: A status message in one of four tones. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from color.status.<tone> through the alert contract tokens. Also picks the default role.

props.name: role
props.description: Live region role. Pass role="none" for a banner that is on the page from the start.
props.default: "status" for info and success, "alert" for warning and critical

props.name: children
props.description: Alert parts, or any content.

components.name: Alert.Title
components.description: Short summary, set in the title weight. A p element.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Attachment.Meta
components.description: A line under the name, such as the file's size and type, or what went wrong. Takes native span attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Size, type, or an error.

components.name: Attachment.Name
components.description: The file name, cut with an ellipsis when it is too long. It names the group, Attachment.Progress and Attachment.Remove. Takes native span attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The file name. Text only.

components.name: Attachment.Preview
components.description: A box of attachment.preview.size beside the name. An img or video, or the img in a picture, covers it and is cropped to it; an svg icon takes attachment.icon.size. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: A thumbnail, such as an img with alt="", or an icon of the file type.

components.name: Attachment.Progress
components.description: A Progress.Root under the name, for an upload. It is named by Attachment.Name unless it has an aria-label or aria-labelledby. Takes native progress attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: How far the upload has come, out of max. Leave it out when the end is unknown.

components.name: Attachment.Remove
components.description: A ghost Button.Root that removes the file. Takes Button.Root props but pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: The button's content. Without it, the close glyph, named by the removeAttachment string, Remove {name} in English.

components.name: Attachment.Root
components.description: One file in a composer or a message, as a div with role="group" named by Attachment.Name unless it has an aria-label or aria-labelledby. The upload is product code: status shows its state. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: status
props.description: Sets data-status. An error takes the attachment.border.error and attachment.meta.fg.error tokens.

components.name: Avatar.Fallback
components.description: Shows until the image loads, and stays when it fails or there is none. Takes native span attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Initials or an icon.

components.name: Avatar.Group
components.description: A div with role="group" that stacks several Avatar.Root, each over the one before, with a ring in the surface color. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Takes native div attributes except role.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, such as "Assignees".

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that names the group, in place of aria-label.

props.name: size
props.description: Size for the avatars inside that set no size of their own. The overlap is a fraction of it, from avatar.group.overlap.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar.Root elements. The last one can be a +N count.

components.name: Avatar.Image
components.description: An img drawn over the fallback, which is removed once the image loads and stays when it fails. Its alt is always empty, because Avatar.Root carries the name. Takes native img attributes except alt.

props.name: src
props.description: The image, or srcSet in its place. Without either, or when it fails to load, the fallback stays.

components.name: Avatar.Root
components.description: A span that shows an image, or a fallback while it loads, when it fails or when there is none. Named by label as one image (role="img"); without label it is hidden from assistive technology. Takes native span attributes except role, aria-label and aria-labelledby.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the avatar, whichever of the image and the fallback shows. Leave it out when the name is written next to the avatar.

props.name: size
props.description: Size from the avatar.size contract tokens. Left out, it is the size of the Avatar.Group around it, or "md".

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors behind the fallback. neutral reads avatar.bg and avatar.fg; other tones read the avatar.<tone> contract tokens. categoryTone(id) picks a stable category per person.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar.Image and Avatar.Fallback.

components.name: Badge.Root
components.description: A short static label or count in a status or category tone. A span with no role; takes native span attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from the badge.<tone> contract tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text or a number.

components.name: BottomSheet.Body
components.description: Scroll container. Drag starts only at scrollTop 0.

components.name: BottomSheet.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Cancel", names the button by itself. Otherwise the close string from StringsProvider names it, Close in English.
props.default: "Close" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the close request. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the sheet open.

components.name: BottomSheet.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text.

components.name: BottomSheet.Footer
components.description: Action row.

components.name: BottomSheet.Grabber
components.description: Drag handle. Rendered by default if omitted. Arrow keys change snap.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the resize control. Default is the resizeSheet string from StringsProvider.

components.name: BottomSheet.Header
components.description: Chrome. Drag-eligible. One row. A BottomSheet.Close placed directly in the header sits at the end with anything after it. What comes before it, such as the title, stays at the start.

components.name: BottomSheet.Root
components.description: Modal bottom sheet on a native <dialog> opened with showModal(). Mid and full snap.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled sheet.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the sheet on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. When controlled, staying open keeps the sheet open. reason is "form" for a <form method="dialog"> submit (read returnValue) and "native" when something else outside Todae closed the <dialog>; when controlled, it shows again while open stays true.

props.name: snap
props.description: Controlled snap. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSnap
props.description: Initial snap when uncontrolled.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Allowed snaps. ["full"] disables mid.

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape"). false sets closedby="none", so the browser ignores the close request.

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").

props.name: dismissOnDrag
props.description: Drag past the threshold dismisses.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when BottomSheet.Title is omitted.

components.name: BottomSheet.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Breadcrumbs.Item
components.description: One step in the trail. An li; takes native li attributes.

props.name: current
props.description: Wraps the text in a span with aria-current="page", marking the page you are on. Give it plain text, not a link.

props.name: children
props.description: A link to the page, such as an a element or your router's link.

components.name: Breadcrumbs.Root
components.description: A nav landmark with an ordered list of the pages above this one. Takes native nav attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Landmark name. Default is the breadcrumbs string from StringsProvider; the server entry always uses English.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of an element that names the landmark. When set, the default name is dropped.

props.name: separator
props.description: Text drawn between items. Screen readers skip it.

props.name: children
props.description: Breadcrumbs.Item elements, from the top page down to this one.

components.name: Button.Group
components.description: Chrome-only attached row of Button.Root. role=group. No selection state.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

props.name: children
props.description: Button.Root children. Horizontal only.

components.name: Button.Icon
components.description: Order-only decorative icon. Always aria-hidden. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic.

components.name: Button.Root
components.description: Native button, or an a through render. Owns variant, type, and disabled. Default type is button.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Non-primary sets data-button-variant.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible name when the only child is Button.Icon. Auto-tip text for icon-only.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Icon-only tips the accessible name. Overflowing labels tip the full string. False opts out. Never tips a fitting labeled button.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled pressed state. Makes the button a toggle with aria-pressed.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Starting pressed state for an uncontrolled toggle. Makes the button a toggle with aria-pressed.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when a toggle is clicked. onClick runs first; preventDefault() there skips the change.

props.name: children
props.description: Label and optional Button.Icon. Order is leading or trailing.

props.name: render
props.description: Draws the button on another element, such as an a or a router link. It receives every prop, ref included, and must pass them to an a or a button. The element keeps its own role, so type, disabled and pressed are not allowed; an a without href looks disabled.

components.name: Calendar.Grid
components.description: The shown month as a role="grid" table, one week to a row, labelled by Calendar.Header's month while one is rendered, unless it has its own aria-label or aria-labelledby. One Tab stop; arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down by month, and with Shift by year. While Calendar.Header shows the years, it is a grid of twelve years in the same pattern, by year and row of four, and by page. In range mode, Escape drops the first pick of a range and stops there, so a popover around the calendar stays open. Takes native table attributes except role and children.

components.name: Calendar.Header
components.description: The shown month and year, announced as they change, between buttons to the previous and next month. The month and year is a button that swaps the grid for a page of twelve years and back; while the years show, the buttons go to the previous and next page. The buttons are named from the previousMonth and nextMonth strings, or previousYears and nextYears, and they and the heading draw the chevron glyph. Takes native div attributes except children.

components.name: Calendar.Root
components.description: A role="group" that holds one selected date, a Temporal.PlainDate, or with mode="range" a DateRange, for its Calendar.Header and Calendar.Grid. In range mode the first pick starts a range and the second ends it, and a range holds only days that can be picked. It shows the month of the date that holds the grid's Tab stop. Todae ships no Temporal polyfill.

props.name: mode
props.description: One date, or with "range" a range of dates: the first pick starts it and the second ends it.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date, or with mode="range" the selected range, or null for none. Pass with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected date, or with mode="range" the initial range, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with each date a person picks, even the one already selected. With mode="range", fires with the range when its second date is picked.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest date that can be picked.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest date that can be picked.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Returns true for a date that cannot be picked, such as a holiday. In range mode, a range can't hold one.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: The month shown first when there is no value. Today's month when not set.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The first column of the grid, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). The locale's own first day when the browser reports it, else 7.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for month and weekday names, such as "ko". The browser's own when not set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops every part from changing the date or month. A disabled Fieldset sets it too.

components.name: Card.Body
components.description: Main content of the card. A div.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

components.name: Card.Footer
components.description: Actions at the end of the card, in a wrapping row aligned to the end. A div.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons or links.

components.name: Card.Header
components.description: Top of the card, for a heading and a short description. A div; headings inside lose their outer margin.

props.name: children
props.description: A heading of the level that fits the page, and optional text.

components.name: Card.Root
components.description: A bordered surface from the card tokens. A div with no role; takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Card parts, or any content.

components.name: categoryTone
components.description: categoryTone(key) returns one of category-1 to category-8 for a string, such as a user id or a tag name. The same key gets the same tone on the server and in every browser.

props.name: key
props.description: A stable key. Composed and decomposed forms of the same text get the same tone.

components.name: Checkbox.Root
components.description: Native checkbox. Children are the visible label.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Clicking the text toggles the input.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state. Defined means controlled.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires after the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid and sets aria-invalid.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: The mixed state, such as a select-all box over a partly selected list. Sets the input's indeterminate and shows the indeterminate glyph in place of the check. A click still toggles checked.

props.name: customValidity
props.description: A message for a rule the browser cannot check, set with setCustomValidity on the checkbox. An empty string or undefined means the rule holds.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: value
props.description: Native input value.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: Chip.Root
components.description: Text-only label with optional named remove button. A +N count is a plain chip with aria-hidden and a VisuallyHidden.Root name beside it.

props.name: children
props.description: Chip label. Text only.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral reads the chip.bg, chip.fg and chip.border state tokens; other tones read the chip.<tone> contract tokens. A disabled chip takes the disabled colors instead.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Renders a named remove button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Remove button aria-label. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {label} in English.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the remove button.

components.name: ChipList.Root
components.description: A list of chips that folds the ones past maxRows into a +N button, which opens a popover with the rest. Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: chips
props.description: Chip labels, in order.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows to show before folding the rest into +N. Without it, every chip wraps onto as many rows as it needs.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable, unique key for each chip, so focus can follow it when chips change. Without it, chips are matched by value, so focus can land on another chip with the same value.

props.name: getTone
props.description: Each chip's tone, such as (value) => categoryTone(value). Without it, every chip is neutral.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Renders a remove button on each chip. Once chips drops the focused chip, focus moves to the chip that now fills its place, else the one before it, else +N, else the list.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Remove button name. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {value} in English.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: +N button name. Default is the moreChips string from StringsProvider, {n} more in English.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Name of the popover with the folded chips. Default is the moreChipsPanel string from StringsProvider, {n} more chips or 1 more chip in English.

components.name: Code.Root
components.description: A native code styled from the code tokens: inline, in the text color around it, on a box tinted from that color. Takes native code attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The code.

components.name: CodeBlock.Root
components.description: A native pre styled from the code.block tokens. It scrolls sideways when a line is too long; takes native pre attributes.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Set 0 when the block can scroll, so keyboard users can reach and scroll it.

props.name: children
props.description: The code, usually in a code element, which drops its own box here.

components.name: ColorPicker.Area
components.description: Saturation left to right and brightness bottom to top, over the current hue. Two native range inputs carry the values: Left and Right change saturation, Up and Down brightness, Shift moves ten steps, and only the saturation input is a Tab stop. Takes div attributes except children.

components.name: ColorPicker.Hue
components.description: A native range input over the hues, 0 to 359 degrees. Takes native input attributes except type, value, defaultValue, min, max, step and disabled.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Its name. Without it, the hue string from StringsProvider names it.

components.name: ColorPicker.Root
components.description: A role="group" that holds the color for its ColorPicker.Area and ColorPicker.Hue. The color is #rrggbb; the parts work in hue, saturation and brightness, and keep the hue while the color is a gray.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled color as #rrggbb. Pass with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial color as #rrggbb when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new color as #rrggbb while it is dragged or keyed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops every part from changing the color. A disabled Fieldset sets it too.

components.name: Composer.Root
components.description: The prompt input of a chat, as a form around a Field.Root with a Field.Textarea. Enter in a textarea of the form sends it, as the form's default button would; Shift+Enter, and Enter that ends an IME composition, do not. Takes native form attributes, such as onSubmit.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called for this form's own submits, not those of a form rendered inside it with createPortal.

props.name: busy
props.description: A response is running: no submit of this form goes through, from Enter, a submit button or requestSubmit, and Composer.Submit turns into Stop. Sets data-busy.

components.name: Composer.Submit
components.description: A Button.Root that sends the form, at the end of a Field.Row. While the composer is busy it is a Stop button instead. Takes Button.Root props but pressed and type: it is a submit button, or a plain button while busy.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when Stop is pressed. Without it, Stop is disabled while the composer is busy.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables Send, such as while nothing is typed. Stop ignores it.

props.name: children
props.description: The button's content. Without it, the send glyph named by the send string, or the stop glyph named by the stop string while busy.

components.name: composeRefs
components.description: composeRefs(...refs) returns one callback ref that sets every given ref, such as your own ref and the one a hook's prop getter returns. It returns a new callback on each call.

props.name: ...refs
props.description: Object refs, callback refs or undefined.

components.name: Conversation.Content
components.description: Holds the messages, spaced by conversation.gap. When an article in it takes aria-busy="true", as Message.Root does while streaming, Conversation announces that a message is arriving; when that clears, that it finished, unless the message holds a role="alert" or another message starts at the same time. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Message.Root elements.

components.name: Conversation.Root
components.description: A conversation of messages that keeps the newest one in view while it grows. It follows the end until the reader scrolls up, and Conversation.ScrollButton brings them back. Give it a height. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: announceMessages
props.description: Whether it tells screen readers when a message starts and finishes arriving, read from aria-busy on the articles in Conversation.Content. The text is the messageStarted and messageFinished strings.

props.name: children
props.description: Conversation.Viewport and Conversation.ScrollButton.

components.name: Conversation.ScrollButton
components.description: A Button.Root over the end of the viewport that scrolls to the newest message, hidden while the reader is at the end. Takes Button.Root props but pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: The button's content. Without it, the chevron glyph, named by the scrollToLatest string.

components.name: Conversation.Viewport
components.description: The scroller, a section that is a region landmark named by the conversation string unless it has aria-label or aria-labelledby. It opens at the end, follows it while the content grows, and stops following when the reader scrolls up. It takes a Tab stop while it overflows and nothing inside can take focus. Takes native section attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Conversation.Content.

components.name: createToaster
components.description: Returns a toast store { add, update, dismiss, remove, subscribe, getSnapshot } that works outside React. Make one per app at module scope and pass it to Toast.Region. add() takes id, tone, title, description, duration and any fields of your own, and returns the id; an id that is still showing is replaced in place.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default milliseconds before a toast dismisses itself. Infinity keeps toasts until dismissed.

components.name: cssVarName
components.description: cssVarName(path) returns the custom property for a token path: --todae- followed by the path with dots as hyphens, so color.fg.default is --todae-color-fg-default.

props.name: path
props.description: A dotted token path. It is not checked against the token list.

components.name: DataList.Details
components.description: A native dd, the value for the term in the same item. Takes native dd attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The value. Put a list of values in one DataList.Details.

components.name: DataList.Item
components.description: A div that groups one term with its details, valid inside a dl. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: One DataList.Term, then one DataList.Details.

components.name: DataList.Root
components.description: A native dl for key and value pairs, such as a settings pane, an order summary or a profile. Takes native dl attributes; orientation sets whether each term sits beside its details or above them.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Sets data-orientation. Horizontal puts each term in a column beside its details, and stacks them when the list is too narrow for both. Vertical puts the term above its details.

props.name: children
props.description: DataList.Item parts.

components.name: DataList.Term
components.description: A native dt, the term for the details beside or below it. Takes native dt attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The term, as text.

components.name: DensityProvider
components.description: Sets data-density for spacing-only compact, comfortable, or spacious.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density written to data-density.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that inherits density tokens.

components.name: Description.Root
components.description: Supporting text below a control. Required id. Sibling, not a Field part. Author wires aria-describedby.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Hint text.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the span.

components.name: Dialog.Body
components.description: Scrollable body.

components.name: Dialog.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Cancel", names the button by itself. Otherwise the close string from StringsProvider names it, Close in English.
props.default: "Close" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the close request. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the dialog open.

components.name: Dialog.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby on the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text.

components.name: Dialog.Footer
components.description: Action row.

components.name: Dialog.Header
components.description: Optional header. One row. A Dialog.Close placed directly in the header sits at the end with anything after it. What comes before it, such as the title, stays at the start.

components.name: Dialog.Root
components.description: Native modal dialog. Stays centered. No sheet morph.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled dialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the dialog on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests. When controlled, staying open keeps the dialog open. Reasons: escape, backdrop, close-button, form (a <form method="dialog"> submit; the submitter value is on the element returnValue), native (something else closed the element).

props.name: role
props.description: alertdialog marks a dialog that interrupts to ask for a response, such as confirming a destructive action. A backdrop click then no longer closes it, and on open focus goes to its first close part, such as a Dialog.Close that says Cancel. It needs a Dialog.Description or an aria-describedby for the message.

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape").

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").
props.default: true, or false when role is alertdialog

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when Dialog.Title is omitted.

components.name: Dialog.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby on the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Disclosure.Root
components.description: A native details styled from the disclosure tokens. Takes native details attributes.

props.name: name
props.description: Disclosures with the same name form an exclusive accordion: the browser keeps at most one open, and a rule divides them.

props.name: open
props.description: Starts the disclosure open. The browser then owns the state; follow it with onToggle.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called after the disclosure opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: A Disclosure.Summary first, then the content it shows and hides.

components.name: Disclosure.Summary
components.description: A native summary: the toggle that stays visible. Takes native summary attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The toggle text. It names the disclosure for screen readers.

components.name: Drawer.Body
components.description: Fills the height the header and footer leave and scrolls on its own.

components.name: Drawer.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that requests close-button dismiss.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits, such as "Cancel", names the button by itself. Otherwise the close string from StringsProvider names it, Close in English.
props.default: "Close" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the close request. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the drawer open.

components.name: Drawer.Description
components.description: Supporting text. Wires aria-describedby on the drawer.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text.

components.name: Drawer.Footer
components.description: Action row. Under a Drawer.Body it sits at the bottom.

components.name: Drawer.Header
components.description: One row. A Drawer.Close placed directly in the header sits at the end with anything after it. What comes before it, such as the title, stays at the start.

components.name: Drawer.Root
components.description: Native modal dialog pinned to the start or end edge, full height. Built from Drawer parts.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out for an uncontrolled drawer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Shows the drawer on mount when uncontrolled. There is no trigger part, so once closed it opens again only on remount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dismiss requests, with the same reasons as Dialog.Root.

props.name: side
props.description: Inline edge it is pinned to. Follows text direction.

props.name: dismissOnEscape
props.description: Escape calls onOpenChange(false, "escape").

props.name: dismissOnBackdrop
props.description: Scrim click calls onOpenChange(false, "backdrop").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when Drawer.Title is omitted.

components.name: Drawer.Title
components.description: Heading. Wires aria-labelledby on the drawer.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Drilldown.Back
components.description: Ghost Button.Root that goes back one view. Renders nothing at the first view. With no content it shows the back glyph.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits names the button by itself. Otherwise the backTo string from StringsProvider names it with the label of the view below, or the back string when that view has no label.
props.default: "Back to {label}" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before going back. Call event.preventDefault() to stay.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content. Without it, the back glyph from GlyphsProvider, or Todae's chevron pointing to the start of the line.

components.name: Drilldown.Label
components.description: span with the shown view's label. Put it in Dialog.Title, Drawer.Title or BottomSheet.Title, so the overlay's title and name follow the view.

components.name: Drilldown.Root
components.description: Owns the stack of views, the first view first and the shown view last. Renders no element, so it can wrap an overlay header and body.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled stack of view values, the first view first and the shown view last. Pass with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial stack when uncontrolled. The stack goes back to it each time an enclosing Dialog, Drawer, BottomSheet or Popover finishes closing, and onValueChange fires with reason reset.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next stack. reason is push (Drilldown.Trigger), back (Drilldown.Back), escape (Escape, or the Android back gesture in a modal) or reset (an uncontrolled stack going back to defaultValue as its overlay finishes closing).

props.name: escape
props.description: back: Escape goes back one view, and closes an enclosing overlay only at the first view. close: Escape is left to the overlay.

props.name: children
props.description: Drilldown.Viewport, Drilldown.Back and Drilldown.Label, anywhere inside.

components.name: Drilldown.Trigger
components.description: Button.Root that pushes its value onto the stack. Takes Button.Root's props, such as variant and render, so it can be a Next button or a row.

props.name: value
props.description: The Drilldown.View to push. Focus returns to this trigger when that view is popped.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button variant.

props.name: render
props.description: Draws the trigger on another element, such as a row or a link, as Button.Root does.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the push. Call event.preventDefault() to stay on this view.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content.

components.name: Drilldown.View
components.description: div with role="group", named by its label. Mounted while its value is in the stack; a view lower in the stack is hidden, and a leaving view is inert and aria-hidden until its slide ends.

props.name: value
props.description: The value Drilldown.Trigger pushes and the stack holds.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the view's group, Drilldown.Label while it shows, and Drilldown.Back from the view above it.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Where focus goes when the view shows with no trigger to return to: on a push, the first time a controlled change shows it, or on a pop once the trigger that pushed the view above is gone. Without it, or when it can't take focus, the first tab stop in the view, or the view itself.

props.name: children
props.description: The view's content.

components.name: Drilldown.Viewport
components.description: div that holds the views. During a slide it stacks the leaving and entering views in one grid cell, clips them, animates its height and sets data-direction to forward or back.

props.name: children
props.description: Drilldown.View elements.

components.name: EmptyState.Actions
components.description: A centered row of buttons or links that wraps. A `div` with no role.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons or links.

components.name: EmptyState.Description
components.description: Muted text under the title, kept to a readable width. A `div`, so it can hold more than one paragraph or a link.

props.name: children
props.description: Description text, or any content.

components.name: EmptyState.Icon
components.description: A slot for any icon, centered above the title. Hidden from assistive technology unless it says otherwise.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic from your own icon set.

components.name: EmptyState.Root
components.description: What a list, table or search shows when it has nothing. A `div` with no role, so it is not announced when it appears; takes native `div` attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: EmptyState parts, or any content.

components.name: EmptyState.Title
components.description: The empty state's heading, at the level `as` names. An `h2` by default.

props.name: as
props.description: The rendered element. Pick the heading level that fits the page, or p to keep the title out of the outline.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: ErrorMessage.Root
components.description: Validation text below a control. With an id it renders as given, with no alert role. Without one, inside a Field.Group or Fieldset.Root in a Form.Root, it shows the scope's error and wires the controls' aria-describedby to itself. invalid lives on the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Id the author lists in aria-describedby on the control or Field.Root. Required outside a validation scope; inside one, leave it out to take the scope's error.

props.name: children
props.description: Error text. Without an id, in a validation scope, a function of the scope's error is allowed too, and no children shows the error's message.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the span.

components.name: Field.Affix
components.description: Order-only text adornment. Not clickable. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Affix content. Strings render as text.

components.name: Field.ChipInput
components.description: Controlled chips plus input inside Field.Root. Commit does not mutate chips. maxRows uses model B.

props.name: chips
props.description: Controlled chip labels.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled input text.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Input text changes.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Fires on a commit key with a trimmed non-empty value. Does not append chips. Return false when there was nothing to commit: Enter then goes on to the form and Tab moves focus, while a character key such as , is still kept from typing.

props.name: onChipRemove
props.description: Remove button click or Backspace on an empty input.

props.name: chipRemoveLabel
props.description: Remove button name. Default is the removeChip string from StringsProvider, Remove {value} in English.

props.name: chipRemoveIcon
props.description: Chip remove button content, such as an icon from your own set. Without it, the close glyph from GlyphsProvider, else Todae's cross.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no chips is invalid, whatever the input holds.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: +N name. Default is the moreChips string from StringsProvider, {n} more in English.

props.name: commitKeys
props.description: Closed allowlist of commit keys.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Caps visual rows. inline: chips plus input. row: chip lines only; the input keeps its own line. Newest chips fold into +N. A chip that does not fit at full width moves into +N. Only a chip wider than the row truncates.

props.name: chipLayout
props.description: inline: chips flow beside the input. row: chips sit in a full-width line above the input, inside the ChipInput; Icon and Affix sit on the first line; no chips renders a one-line field the height of TextInput.

props.name: removeOnBackspace
props.description: Backspace on an empty input removes the last chip.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

components.name: Field.ColorPicker
components.description: A button one line of field text tall, filled with the color, that opens a ColorPicker in a popover. On its own it is the field's control, and a press elsewhere in the field opens the picker. Beside any other control in the field but a Field.ColorPicker, Field.DatePicker, Field.DateRangePicker, Field.TimePicker or Field.DateTimePicker, such as a Field.TextInput, that control is the field's control instead, and the button is named from the colorPicker string. The color goes in a native text input under the field's name unless another control took it, so Field.Root's customValidity and a Form.Root scope see it. Takes native button attributes except type, value, defaultValue, color, onChange and children.

props.name: value
props.description: The color as #rrggbb.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new color as #rrggbb while it is dragged or keyed in the picker.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the picker. Pass with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the picker opens or closes, with why it closed.

components.name: Field.Counter
components.description: Live character count for Field.TextInput or Field.Textarea. Its screen reader text comes from the characterLimit, charactersLeft and characterLimitReached strings of StringsProvider.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the count. Use it for the inline flex-basis override.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style. flex-basis: auto places the count on the input row.

components.name: Field.DatePicker
components.description: A button that opens a Calendar in a popover and closes it on a picked date. On its own it is the field's control, shows the date, and a press elsewhere in the field opens the calendar. Beside any other control but a Field.ColorPicker, Field.DatePicker, Field.DateRangePicker, Field.TimePicker or Field.DateTimePicker, such as a Field.TextInput to type the date in, that control is the field's control instead, and the button is named from the datePicker string. The date goes in a native input the browser validates, so required, min and max block a submit and Form.Root shows them. With showValue set to false, the button shows only a calendar glyph. Takes native button attributes except type, value, defaultValue, placeholder, onChange and children.

props.name: value
props.description: The date, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the date picked in the calendar.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest date that can be picked. A form with an earlier date is invalid.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest date that can be picked. A form with a later date is invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no date is invalid.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Returns true for a date that cannot be picked, such as a holiday.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The calendar's first column, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). The locale's own first day when the browser reports it, else 7.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for the button's date and the calendar's names, such as "ko". The browser's own when not set, so pass it when the picker renders on a server.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the button while there is no date, when showValue is true.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether the button shows the date, or the placeholder, beside its glyph. Set it to false beside a text input that shows the date.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the calendar. Pass with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the calendar opens or closes, with why it closed.

components.name: Field.DateRangePicker
components.description: A button that opens a Calendar in range mode in a popover, which closes once the range's second date is picked. On its own it is the field's control, shows the range, and a press elsewhere in the field opens the calendar. Beside any other control but a Field.ColorPicker, Field.DatePicker, Field.DateRangePicker, Field.TimePicker or Field.DateTimePicker, such as a Field.TextInput to type the range in, that control is the field's control instead, and the button is named from the dateRangePicker string. With showValue set to false, the button shows only a calendar glyph. The range goes in a native text input under the field's name unless another control took it, as an ISO 8601 interval such as 2026-10-03/2026-10-10, so required blocks a submit and Form.Root shows it. Takes native button attributes except type, value, defaultValue, placeholder, onChange and children.

props.name: value
props.description: The range, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the range picked in the calendar, once its second date is picked.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest date that can be picked.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest date that can be picked.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no range is invalid.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Returns true for a date that cannot be picked, such as a holiday. A range can't hold one.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The calendar's first column, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). The locale's own first day when the browser reports it, else 7.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for the button's dates and the calendar's names, such as "ko". The browser's own when not set, so pass it when the picker renders on a server.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the button while there is no range, when showValue is true.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether the button shows the range, or the placeholder, beside its glyph. Set it to false beside a text input that shows the range.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the calendar. Pass with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the calendar opens or closes, with why it closed.

components.name: Field.DateTimePicker
components.description: A button that opens a Calendar and a list of times in a popover, side by side, or the list under the calendar on a narrow screen. A picked date and a picked time make the value, and picking a time while the calendar holds a date it offers closes the popover. On its own it is the field's control, shows the date and time, and a press elsewhere in the field opens the popover. Beside any other control but a Field.ColorPicker, Field.DatePicker, Field.DateRangePicker, Field.TimePicker or Field.DateTimePicker, such as a Field.TextInput to type the date and time in, that control is the field's control instead, and the button is named from the dateTimePicker string. The date and time go in a native input the browser validates, so required, min and max block a submit and Form.Root shows them. With showValue set to false, the button shows only a calendar glyph. Takes native button attributes except type, value, defaultValue, placeholder, onChange and children.

props.name: value
props.description: The date and time, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the date and time when a pick leaves a date the calendar offers and a time in range for it.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest date and time that can be picked. A form with an earlier one is invalid.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest date and time that can be picked. A form with a later one is invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no date and time is invalid.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Returns true for a date that cannot be picked, such as a holiday.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The calendar's first column, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). The locale's own first day when the browser reports it, else 7.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the times in the list, from midnight.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for the button's text, the calendar's names and the times, such as "ko". The browser's own when not set, so pass it when the picker renders on a server.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the button while there is no date and time, when showValue is true.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether the button shows the date and time, or the placeholder, beside its glyph. Set it to false beside a text input that shows them.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the popover. Pass with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the popover opens or closes, with why it closed.

components.name: Field.Decrement
components.description: A button that lowers the number of the field's Field.NumberInput by its step. It is not a tab stop and keeps focus in the input, holding it repeats, and it is disabled where a step would do nothing, such as at min or while the text is no number. It is named from the decrement string of StringsProvider unless its own text names it, and draws the minus glyph of GlyphsProvider. Takes native button attributes except type.

props.name: children
props.description: Content that replaces the minus sign. Text in it names the button.

components.name: Field.Group
components.description: Column that stacks a Label.Root or caption, the control, then Description.Root and ErrorMessage.Root. The label or caption sits field.label.gap above the control; the messages keep the distances they have outside a group. Renders a div outside Field.Root. Inside a Form.Root it is a validation scope: its controls' native problems show in an ErrorMessage.Root with no id.

props.name: children
props.description: A label or caption, the control, then any Description.Root and ErrorMessage.Root.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the group.

components.name: Field.Icon
components.description: Order-only icon. Decorative unless interactive. No side prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon or control.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When false, the wrapper is aria-hidden.

components.name: Field.Increment
components.description: A button that raises the number of the field's Field.NumberInput by its step. It is not a tab stop and keeps focus in the input, holding it repeats, and it is disabled where a step would do nothing, such as at max or while the text is no number. It is named from the increment string of StringsProvider unless its own text names it, and draws the plus glyph of GlyphsProvider. Takes native button attributes except type.

props.name: children
props.description: Content that replaces the plus sign. Text in it names the button.

components.name: Field.NumberInput
components.description: A text input for a number, in the locale's own format, that the person types into freely. It parses on blur, Enter and each step, rewrites the text and calls onValueChange. The number goes in a native input the browser validates, so required, min and max block a submit and Form.Root shows them in the field's format. Arrow Up and Down step, Page Up and Page Down step by largeStep. Field.Increment and Field.Decrement beside it are step buttons. It is a native input with the spinbutton role, and takes native input attributes except type, role, value, defaultValue, onChange, min, max, step, disabled, required, pattern, maxLength, minLength, list and multiple.

props.name: value
props.description: The number, or null for none. Never NaN.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on a person's commit, on blur, Enter, a step key, a step button or a submit of the form, with a number within min and max and, where there is a step, on it, which wins over the digits the text shows; without one, rounded to them. Null for an empty text. Typing alone fires nothing. Without it the input is read-only.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest number. A commit below it becomes it, and a form with a lower value is invalid.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest number. A commit above it becomes the highest number on the step that fits.

props.name: step
props.description: The grid a commit snaps to, counted from min, or from 0 without one (a value you set that is off it is shown as given, and Todae warns once in development), and what the arrow keys and step buttons move by. It wins over the digits the text shows, so give a step no finer than they are. Without it a commit keeps every digit the text shows, and a key moves by 1, or by 0.01 for a percent.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: What Page Up and Page Down move by, rounded to whole steps and at least one. Todae warns in development when it is not a multiple of step.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for the number's text, such as "de". The browser's own when not set, so pass it when the input renders on a server.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the number is written, as Intl.NumberFormat takes it: style, such as percent or currency, and fraction digits, which a commit rounds to. Compact and scientific notation can't be read back, and significant digits and rounding options are not supported. Put a unit or a currency sign in a Field.Affix instead when you can.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no number is invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Which keyboard a phone shows. The decimal keypad's separator is the device's, not locale's.
props.default: "numeric" for a whole grid (step and min whole numbers) with a min of 0 or more in a format that shows no fraction digits, "decimal" for any other min of 0 or more, else "text"

components.name: Field.Root
components.description: Field chrome only. No value. Children render in source order.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and marks the shell.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the shell invalid and sets aria-invalid on the input.

props.name: customValidity
props.description: A message for a rule the browser cannot check, set with setCustomValidity on the field's control when that is a native input, select or textarea, else on its value input, as a Field.DatePicker has. An empty string or undefined means the rule holds.

props.name: id
props.description: Input id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of Description and ErrorMessage. Put this on Root. Input parts add their own ids after these.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input name.

props.name: ref
props.description: Shell element. Use as a Popover anchorRef.

props.name: children
props.description: TextInput or ChipInput plus optional Icon and Affix. Order is leading/trailing.

components.name: Field.Row
components.description: Full-width line of parts inside Field.Root. Placement = where it is written. Empty Row renders nothing.

props.name: children
props.description: Parts for the line, such as chips, buttons or Field.Counter.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the row.

components.name: Field.Select
components.description: Controlled native <select> inside Field.Root. The picker is styled from tokens where appearance: base-select is supported.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler. Optional when onValueChange is enough.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: children
props.description: Native <option> and <optgroup> elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the select.

components.name: Field.Textarea
components.description: Controlled multi-line text inside Field.Root. Height is CSS only.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler. Optional when onValueChange is enough.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

props.name: rows
props.description: Starting height in rows. Also the native rows attribute and the drag floor.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Caps autoGrow and drag-resize. Omitted means no cap.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grows with content up to maxRows using CSS only. No maxRows means no cap.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Ranges of the text, { start, end, kind?, anchorName?, draw? }, drawn as tokens on a layer behind it. useMentions' getTextareaProps sets it.

components.name: Field.TextInput
components.description: Controlled text-ish input inside Field.Root.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler. Optional when onValueChange is enough.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional value callback.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native placeholder.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type. A number uses Field.NumberInput, a time Field.TimePicker, a date Field.DatePicker, a range of dates Field.DateRangePicker and both Field.DateTimePicker, with a text input beside any of the pickers read by parseTime, parseDate, parseDateRange or parseDateTime.

components.name: Field.TimePicker

Beside any other control but a Field.ColorPicker, Field.DatePicker, Field.DateRangePicker, Field.TimePicker or Field.DateTimePicker, such as a Field.TextInput to type the time in, that control is the field's control instead, and the button is named from the timePicker string. Takes native button attributes except type, value, defaultValue, placeholder, onChange and children.

props.name: value
props.description: The time, or null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the time picked in the list.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest time the list offers. A form with an earlier time is invalid. Later than max, it makes an overnight range, from min through midnight to max.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest time the list offers. A form with a later time is invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: A form with no time is invalid.

props.name: step
