props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for the times' text, such as "ko". The browser's own when not set, so pass it when the picker renders on a server.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the button while there is no time, when showValue is true.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether the button shows the time, or the placeholder, beside its glyph. Set it to false beside a text input that shows the time.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the list. Pass with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the list opens or closes, with why it closed.

components.name: Fieldset.Legend
components.description: The native legend that names the group. Render it as the first child of Fieldset.Root.

props.name: children
props.description: Group name.

components.name: Fieldset.Root
components.description: A native fieldset that groups related controls, such as a set of checkboxes, under one Legend. Takes native fieldset attributes. Inside a Form.Root it is a validation scope: its controls' native problems show in an ErrorMessage.Root with no id.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled: every form control inside is disabled. Todae controls inside also show their disabled style.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the Todae controls inside invalid (aria-invalid and the invalid style); a control with invalid={false} opts out. A fieldset has no aria-invalid of its own, so point aria-describedby at an ErrorMessage.

props.name: customValidity
props.description: A message for a rule the browser cannot check, set with setCustomValidity on the fieldset's own first control that takes part in validation; when all its controls sit in nested groups, on the first one at any depth, where its error shows. An empty string or undefined means the rule holds. Warns in development when there is no such control.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of a Description or ErrorMessage for the whole group.

props.name: children
props.description: A Fieldset.Legend first, then the controls.

components.name: Form.Root
components.description: A native form that checks its controls before it submits and shows each problem in a Field.Group or Fieldset.Root. Sets noValidate. Takes native form attributes.

props.name: errors
props.description: Problems you found, such as a server reply, keyed by a control name. Todae never writes it: clear it when you send, in onSubmit, and set it when the reply comes. Entries show at once in place of the control's native problem and do not block a submit. An edit to a control hides its entry until the next submit, or until errors drops that name or changes its text. After a send, a reply is a commit whose content differs from the commit before and has entries (clear-then-set counts, a rebuild of the same content does not); it moves focus to the summary or the first enabled control with a server error and lists only server errors.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Runs for a submit with every control valid, or one sent by a submit button with formNoValidate, which is a send without the check that reveals nothing new. Form.Root checks first, and a submit with a problem does not reach it.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Runs on this form's reset, not a portaled form's, as onSubmit does. A reset hides every shown problem again.

props.name: children
props.description: The controls, usually in Field.Group and Fieldset.Root, and an optional Form.Summary.

components.name: Form.Summary
components.description: The problems a failed submit left, as links to their controls, or buttons for a control with no id. A failed submit moves focus to it. Renders nothing before one, or when no problem is left. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: title
props.description: Replaces the title, which is the formErrors string with the number of problems.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the list of links. Each field has its name, label, error, whether it is disabled and a focus() that moves focus to its control.

components.name: formatDate
components.description: formatDate(date, options) returns the date as the locale writes it in numbers, such as 10/13/2026 in en-US, 13.10.2026 in de and 2026. 10. 13. in ko,. A date in another calendar is written as the same day in the Gregorian calendar.

props.name: date
props.description: The date to write.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: formatDateRange
components.description: formatDateRange(range, options) returns the range as the locale writes it, both dates as formatDate writes them with the locale's range separator between, such as 10/3/2026 – 10/10/2026 in en-US and 2026. 10. 3. ~ 2026. 10. 10. in ko.

props.name: range
props.description: The range to write, as { start, end }. The earlier date comes first, even when it is the end.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: formatDateTime
components.description: formatDateTime(value, options) returns the date and time as the locale writes them, the date in numbers as formatDate does and the time in hours and minutes, or with seconds when it has seconds, such as 10/13/2026, 9:30 PM in en-US.

props.name: value
props.description: The date and time to write.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: formatNumber
components.description: formatNumber(value, options) returns the number as the locale writes it, such as 1,234.5 in en-US and 1.234,5 in de. formatOptions sets the style, such as percent or currency, and the digits; a plain number shows all the digits it has.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to write.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as de. The runtime's own when not set.

props.name: options.formatOptions
props.description: How the number is written, as Intl.NumberFormat takes it: style, such as percent or currency, and fraction digits.

components.name: formatTime
components.description: formatTime(time, options) returns the time in the locale's short time style, such as 9:30 PM in en-US and 21:30 in de, or in its medium style, with seconds, when the time has seconds.

props.name: time
props.description: The time to write.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: GlyphsProvider
components.description: Sets the glyphs Todae draws by itself, such as close crosses, check marks and chevrons, for its subtree, so they can come from your icon library. Renders no element; useGlyphs() reads the glyphs in effect.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: The glyphs to change, by the keys of the Glyphs type. Each key left out comes from the nearest GlyphsProvider above; null brings back Todae's own. A part's own content still wins.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that uses these glyphs.

components.name: Grid.Root
components.description: CSS grid layout, the two-axis partner to Stack. Gap comes from the grid.gap contract token. Pass at most one of columns or minItemSize; with neither, set gridTemplateColumns yourself.

props.name: columns
props.description: A fixed number of equal columns, a whole number from 1.

props.name: minItemSize
props.description: The narrowest a column may get, as a CSS length such as "12rem". As many columns fit as the width allows.

props.name: children
props.description: Laid-out children.

components.name: Kbd.Root
components.description: A native kbd drawn as a key cap from the kbd tokens. One with keys or samp inside stays plain text. Takes native kbd attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: A key name, or for a shortcut one Kbd.Root per key.

components.name: Label.Root
components.description: Visible name for a control. Sibling, not a Field part. Pass htmlFor the control id.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the labelled control. Must match Field.Root id when captioning a Field.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. A required mark is authored here when needed.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the native label.

components.name: Link.Root
components.description: A link styled from the link tokens. Renders an a, or a router link through render; takes native a attributes.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. Without it the element is not a link and gets no link style.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders something other than a plain a, such as a router link. It receives every prop, the class name included, and must pass them to an a.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Marks the link to the current page or step; its underline thickens.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text.

components.name: Loader.Root
components.description: A native progress with no value, drawn from the loader tokens as a spinner or a wave through three dots. Takes native progress attributes except value and max.

props.name: variant
props.description: spinner turns one arc of a ring; dots sends a wave through three dots, as a typing indicator does. Sets data-variant.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the indicator when it is not inside a label with text. It keeps the progressbar role, so it needs a name.

components.name: Menu.CheckboxItem
components.description: role="menuitemcheckbox". Toggles aria-checked; stays open by default.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fires with the next checked state.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after toggling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled. Stays in the arrow-key order, so it is announced, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Typeahead text when children are not plain text.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Content
components.description: role="menu" in a popover anchored to the trigger. Named by the trigger unless aria-label or aria-labelledby is given.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu instead of the trigger.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that names the menu. Default is the trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Items, groups and separators.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Group
components.description: role="group" inside a menu. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Group name. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible group caption.

props.name: children
props.description: Items.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Item
components.description: role="menuitem". Enter, Space or a click runs onSelect and closes the menu.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs when the item is chosen.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after choosing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled. Stays in the arrow-key order, so it is announced, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Typeahead text when children are not plain text.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders the item on another element, such as an a or a router link that goes somewhere when chosen. It receives every prop, ref included, and must pass them on.

components.name: Menu.RadioGroup
components.description: A Menu.Group that owns one value for its Menu.RadioItem children.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. null is controlled with nothing checked.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Group name. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of a visible group caption.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu.RadioItem children.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.RadioItem
components.description: role="menuitemradio" in a Menu.RadioGroup. Stays open by default.

props.name: value
props.description: Value this item sets on its group.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after choosing.

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled. Stays in the arrow-key order, so it is announced, but cannot be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Typeahead text when children are not plain text.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Root
components.description: Owns open state for one action menu. Renders no element.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on open and close. reason is trigger, escape, outside, select or tab. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu.Trigger and Menu.Content.

components.name: Menu.Separator
components.description: role="separator" between items or groups.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class.

components.name: Menu.Trigger
components.description: Button.Root wired as the menu button: aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded, ArrowDown and ArrowUp open.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button variant.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Button tooltip. Off by default on a menu trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label.

components.name: Message.Actions
components.description: A row below the content for the message's actions, such as copy and retry. A div; put a Toolbar.Root in it for arrow-key focus.

props.name: reveal
props.description: hover hides the row until the pointer is over the message or focus is inside it. On a screen with no hover, such as a phone, it always shows.

props.name: children
props.description: Buttons, or a Toolbar.Root holding them.

components.name: Message.Avatar
components.description: A slot beside the message for an Avatar.Root. A div; with one, the other parts sit in a column next to it, before it for a user's message.

props.name: children
props.description: An Avatar.Root.

components.name: Message.Content
components.description: The message body. A div; for a user's message it is the bubble.

props.name: children
props.description: The text, often a Prose.Root with rendered markdown.

components.name: Message.Header
components.description: A row above the content for the author's name and a Message.Time. A div; headings and paragraphs directly inside lose their margin.

props.name: children
props.description: The author's name and, if any, a Message.Time.

components.name: Message.Root
components.description: A turn of a conversation, as an article from the message tokens. from sets the layout: a user's message sits at the end side in a bubble, a system message is a quiet centered line. Takes native article attributes.

props.name: from
props.description: Who wrote the message. Sets data-from, which sets layout and tokens only.

props.name: streaming
props.description: True while the message is still arriving. Sets aria-busy and data-streaming. Set it back to false when the message finishes or fails.

props.name: children
props.description: Message parts: Avatar, Header, Content and Actions.

components.name: Message.Time
components.description: When the message was sent, as a time element from the message.time tokens. dateTime is the instant in UTC, and the text is the value written for locale with Intl in the value's time zone and the Gregorian calendar, in the short time style unless dateStyle or timeStyle is set, such as 9:41 AM in en-US. Takes native time attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: When the message was sent, in the time zone to show it in.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale to write it in, such as "ko". The runtime's own when not set, so set it when a server renders the message.

props.name: dateStyle
props.description: Intl's dateStyle. With neither style set, the time is written in the short time style.

props.name: timeStyle
props.description: Intl's timeStyle. With neither style set, it is short.

props.name: children
props.description: Text to show in place of the formatted value, such as "2 min ago". dateTime still comes from value.

components.name: Meter.Root
components.description: A native meter drawn as a track and a fill from the progress and meter tokens. Takes native meter attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: The measurement, between min and max.

props.name: min
props.description: The low end of the range.

props.name: max
props.description: The high end of the range.

props.name: low
props.description: Where the low part of the range ends.

props.name: high
props.description: Where the high part of the range starts.

props.name: optimum
props.description: The best value. With low and high it decides whether the fill is meter.fill.optimum, meter.fill.suboptimum or meter.fill.critical.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the meter when no label element points at it.

props.name: children
props.description: The value as text, for browsers that do not draw the meter.

components.name: Nav.Branch
components.description: A native details with a toggle and a nested list. Takes native details attributes.

props.name: label
props.description: The toggle's text. After a Nav.Link in the same item, the toggle shows only a chevron and this text only names it, so name the child pages, such as "Field pages".

props.name: open
props.description: Sets whether the branch is open when it renders and whenever the prop changes: true opens it, false closes it. In between, the user opens and closes it; follow that with onToggle.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called after the branch opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: Nav.Item elements, the child pages.

components.name: Nav.Group
components.description: A list of Nav.Item elements with an optional label above it. A div holding a ul; takes native div attributes.

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown above the list. It also names the list for screen readers.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the list when it has no label, or in place of it. aria-labelledby goes on the list too.

props.name: children
props.description: Nav.Item elements.

components.name: Nav.Item
components.description: One entry in a Nav.Group or Nav.Branch. An li; takes native li attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: A Nav.Link, a Nav.Branch, or a Nav.Link followed by the Nav.Branch of its child pages.

components.name: Nav.Link
components.description: A link drawn as a nav row. Renders an a, or a router link through render; takes native a attributes.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders something other than a plain a, such as a router link. It receives every prop, the class name included, and must pass them to an a.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Marks the link to the page you are on, which draws it as the current row.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text, with an optional icon before it.

components.name: Nav.Root
components.description: A nav landmark that stacks Nav.Group lists. Takes native nav attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Landmark name. Give one when the page has more than one nav, such as "Docs" beside a header nav.

props.name: children
props.description: Nav.Group elements.

components.name: normalizeHex
components.description: normalizeHex(text) returns #rrggbb in lower case for a three- or six-digit hex color, with or without #, and null for anything else.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to read, such as typed input. Spaces around it are ignored.

components.name: OptionList.Option
components.description: String-only option inside OptionList.Root.

props.name: value
props.description: Selection value.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. Text only.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skips pointer and keyboard selection. Use aria-disabled instead of disabled for an option that is unavailable for now but stays reachable.

components.name: OptionList.Root
components.description: Overlay listbox. Single or multiple. Use RadioGroup or Checkbox for a permanent choice on the page.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single fires onValueChange(string). Multiple fires onValueChange(string[]).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value, or values when selectionMode is multiple.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Selection change. Single passes a string. Multiple passes the next array.

props.name: id
props.description: Listbox id. Auto-generated when omitted. Option ids derive from it.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Listbox tabIndex. Pass -1 when a combobox input owns focus.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Controlled highlighted value. Omit to keep highlight inside the list.

props.name: onActiveValueChange
props.description: Fires when keyboard or pointer moves the highlight.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name when no visible label is present.

components.name: Pagination.Ellipsis
components.description: Stands for the pages a gap leaves out. Hidden from assistive technology. Takes native li attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: What the gap shows.

components.name: Pagination.Item
components.description: One page or the previous or next step, as a list item around your link or button. Its control is drawn as the current page when it has aria-current="page" and muted when it has aria-disabled="true". Takes native li attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: A link or button.

components.name: Pagination.Root
components.description: A nav landmark around an ordered list of pages. Named by the pagination string from StringsProvider ("Pagination" in English; always English in the server entry) unless a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby is passed. Takes native nav attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: Pagination.Item and Pagination.Ellipsis parts, often from paginationRange.

components.name: paginationRange
components.description: Returns the pages to show as numbers, with "start-ellipsis" and "end-ellipsis" for the gaps. While there are more pages than slots the list keeps one length, and a gap always stands for two or more pages.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1. Clamped to 1..count.

props.name: count
props.description: How many pages there are. Below 1, or not a finite number, gives an empty list.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

props.name: boundaries
props.description: Pages always shown at each end.

components.name: parseDate
components.description: parseDate(text, options) returns the Temporal.PlainDate in typed text, or null when the text is not a date. It reads a date in numbers in the order formatDate writes them, or in the locale's medium, long or full Intl date style. It does not check a picker's min, max or isDateDisabled.

props.name: text
props.description: The typed text.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: parseDateRange
components.description: parseDateRange(text, options) returns the DateRange in typed text, two dates that parseDate reads with a separator between them, such as 10/3/2026 – 10/10/2026 in en-US, the earlier date as its start, or null when the text is not one. Each date needs its year, as formatDateRange writes them. It does not check a picker's min, max or isDateDisabled.

props.name: text
props.description: The typed text, with a year on each date.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: parseDateTime
components.description: parseDateTime(text, options) returns the Temporal.PlainDateTime in typed text, or null when the text is not one. It reads a date and a time in the order the locale writes them, such as 10/13/2026 9:30 pm or Oct 13, 2026 at 9:30 PM in en-US. It does not check a picker's min, max or isDateDisabled.

props.name: text
props.description: The typed text.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: parseNumber
components.description: parseNumber(text, options) returns the number in typed text, or null when the text is not a number in the locale, such as 1.234,5 in de for 1234.5. It reads the text with or without grouping, and with or without the percent sign, currency sign or unit that formatOptions writes.

props.name: text
props.description: The typed text.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as de. The runtime's own when not set.

props.name: options.formatOptions
props.description: How the number is written, as Intl.NumberFormat takes it. A percent style reads 13 as 0.13.

components.name: parseThemeColor
components.description: parseThemeColor(text) returns an oklch ThemeColorValue for a color such as #3366cc, converted to oklch, or oklch(0.5 0.1 30 / 0.8). It returns null for text it does not read, such as oklch(50% 0.1 30), and for a color out of range, such as a lightness above 1.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to read. Spaces around it are ignored.

components.name: parseThemeValue
components.description: parseThemeValue(key, text) reads text as a ThemeProvider override value of the key's type, such as 1.5rem for a dimension or 200ms for a duration, or returns null for text it does not read, such as 16px for a dimension.

props.name: key
props.description: A key from THEME_OVERRIDE_KEYS. Its type decides how the text is read.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to read. Spaces around it are ignored.

components.name: parseTime
components.description: parseTime(text, options) returns the Temporal.PlainTime in typed text, or null when the text is not a time. It reads an hour, an hour and minutes, or an hour, minutes and seconds, with or without the locale's words for a part of the day, such as 9:30 pm in en-US.

props.name: text
props.description: The typed text.

props.name: options.locale
props.description: The locale, such as ko. The runtime's own when not set.

components.name: Popover.Root
components.description: Surface chrome. Spread getPopoverProps for wire.

props.name: children
props.description: Popover contents.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the surface.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the surface. Anchor position comes from getPopoverProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Only with role="dialog"; a role-less popover drops it, so name its contents instead.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Only with role="dialog"; a role-less popover drops it.

props.name: role
props.description: Non-modal dialog role. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Does not set aria-modal.

components.name: Progress.Root
components.description: A native progress drawn as a track and a fill from the progress tokens. Takes native progress attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: How far the task has come, from 0 to max. Leave it out when the end is unknown: a band sweeps the track.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at which the task is done.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the bar when no label element points at it. Every progress bar needs a name.

props.name: children
props.description: The value as text, for browsers that do not draw the bar.

components.name: Prose.Root
components.description: A div that styles the headings, paragraphs, lists and block quotes of rendered markdown inside it, and spaces its children. An element of any other kind, such as a div, table or pre, stops the styles from reaching what it holds; takes native div attributes.

components.name: RadioGroup.Item
components.description: One option in a RadioGroup. No checked, name, or invalid. Children are the visible label.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value. The group owns selection.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this option. The group disabled flag also applies.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the wrapping label.

components.name: RadioGroup.Root
components.description: Exclusive choice. Requires aria-label or aria-labelledby. Owns value, name, disabled, and invalid.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. null is controlled with nothing selected. Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next selected value.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared native name. Generated when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks every radio invalid.

props.name: customValidity
props.description: A message for a rule the browser cannot check, set with setCustomValidity on the first radio that takes part in validation. An empty string or undefined means the rule holds.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout and aria-orientation.

props.name: children
props.description: RadioGroup.Item children.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the radiogroup.

components.description: resolveSheetPresentation({ coarse, narrow }) returns sheet when either is true, else popover: useSheetPresentation's rule without its media queries.

props.name: coarse
props.description: Whether the pointer is coarse.

props.name: narrow
props.description: Whether the viewport is narrow.

components.name: ScrollArea.Root
components.description: A div that scrolls and keeps the focus rings of what it holds whole: its children sit in a content box padded by a ring's room, and it scroll-pads by the same. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: axis
props.description: The direction it scrolls in. The other direction is clipped.

components.name: Table.HeaderCell

components.name: Table.Root

props.name: children
props.description: A Table.Caption, then Table.Head, Table.Body and Table.Foot with their rows and cells.

components.name: Table.Row
components.description: A native tr. Takes native tr attributes.

props.name: selected

props.name: children
props.description: Table.HeaderCell and Table.Cell parts.

components.name: Table.SortButton
components.description: A native button for a sortable column, inside a Table.HeaderCell that takes sort. It draws the sort glyph after its children, from the header cell's data-sort: shown on a sorted column, turned when it is descending, and dimmed when unsorted; on a device with a hovering pointer it shows only on hover or focus. It does not sort; set the cell's sort from onClick. After a click it announces the column's next aria-sort or data-sort change through useAnnouncer, if it comes before the user's next press or key; a lone modifier key does not count. Takes native button attributes.

props.name: children
props.description: The column label. It names the button, and the announcement uses its text, or aria-label when set.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Where the product sorts. It runs first; calling preventDefault() skips the announcement.

components.name: Tabs.List
components.description: The tablist. Holds one tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

components.name: Tabs.Root

components.name: Text.Root

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight.

props.name: children
props.description: Text content.

props.description: An oklch color, as parseThemeColor returns.

components.name: themeOverrideStyle
components.description: themeOverrideStyle(overrides, overrideTypes) returns the public --todae-* custom properties ThemeProvider sets for overrides, as a style object such as { "--todae-color-fg-default": "oklch(0.2 0 0)" }. An unknown key or a value of the wrong type throws in development and is skipped in production.

props.name: overrides

props.name: overrideTypes

components.name: themeOverrideType
components.description: themeOverrideType(key) returns the $type of one of Todae's ThemeProvider override keys, such as color or dimension.

props.name: key

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.description: Sets data-appearance from system, light, or dark. Nested providers override.

props.description: Written to data-appearance as is. system follows prefers-color-scheme in CSS. Leave it out on a nested provider that only sets overrides.

props.name: key

props.name: value
props.description: A value of the key's type.

components.name: Toast.Action
components.description: Button.Root for the toast's one action, such as Undo. Dismisses the toast after onClick.

props.name: variant
props.description: Button variant.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs the action. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the toast open.

props.name: render
props.description: Draws the action on a link, such as View, as Button.Root's render does.

components.name: Toast.Close
components.description: Ghost Button.Root at the end of the first row that dismisses the toast.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Text of two or more letters or digits names the button by itself. Otherwise the dismiss string from StringsProvider names it, Dismiss in English.
props.default: "Dismiss" when its text, not counting aria-hidden or SVG parts, has fewer than two letters or digits

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs before the toast is dismissed. Call event.preventDefault() to keep it open.

components.name: Toast.Description
components.description: Longer text under the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Description content.

components.name: Toast.Icon
components.description: Slot for any icon, placed before the text. aria-hidden by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon graphic from your own icon set.

components.name: Toast.Region
components.description: Where toasts show, in a popover="manual" element in the top layer. Render one near the app root. While a modal dialog in Todae's modal stack is open, the toasts move inside it so they stay usable. Takes native section attributes.

props.name: toaster
props.description: The store from createToaster().

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one toast, usually a Toast.Root.

props.name: placement
props.description: Corner or edge of the viewport. The newest toast sits nearest the edge.

props.name: layout
props.description: list shows every toast in full. stack collapses them behind the newest and spreads them while the pointer is over them or keyboard focus is inside, and from a tap with a finger or a pen that isn't hovering until a press outside or no toast is left.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts show at once. Later ones wait their turn.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Key that moves focus to the toasts, such as "F8" or "Alt+T". Modifiers are Alt (or Option), Ctrl, Meta (or Cmd) and Shift. null turns it off.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the region landmark. Default is the notifications string from StringsProvider.

components.name: Toast.Root
components.description: One toast, in one of four tones. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from color.status.<tone> through the toast contract tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Toast parts, or any content.

components.name: Toast.Title
components.description: Short summary, set in the title weight. A p element.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: ToggleGroup.Item
components.description: A secondary Button.Root with aria-pressed from the group. Takes Button.Root props except the pressed ones.

props.name: value

props.name: disabled

props.name: children

components.name: ToggleGroup.Root
components.description: role="group" of toggle buttons with one tab stop and arrow-key focus. Inside a Toolbar, the toolbar owns the arrow keys. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group, such as "Alignment".

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single presses one item at most; pressing it again clears it. Multiple presses any number.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled pressed value: a value or null for single, an array for multiple.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group, such as "Text style".

props.name: children
props.description: Controls in the group.

components.description: role="toolbar" whose controls share one tab stop, apart from text inputs and others that keep their own. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between the focusable controls inside, wrappers included. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the toolbar. Pass this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Left and Right move focus in a horizontal toolbar, Up and Down in a vertical one. Left and Right follow the text direction.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last control to the first and back.

components.description: role="separator" drawn across the toolbar: a vertical rule in a horizontal toolbar, a horizontal one in a vertical toolbar. Not focusable.

components.description: Tip chrome. Spread getTooltipProps for wire.

props.name: children
props.description: Tooltip text, or short prose plus links when interactive.

props.description: Class name for the tip surface.

props.description: Style for the tip surface. Anchor position comes from getTooltipProps.

props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

components.name: Tree.Group
components.description: A role="group" list of the Tree.Item children of an item. Hidden while that item is closed.

props.description: Tree.Item children. Leave it empty for a branch whose children load when it opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the group.

components.description: An aria-hidden slot for an icon before the item text. An svg or img inside takes tree.icon.size.

props.name: children
props.description: The icon, such as a file or folder from your icon library.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the slot.

components.name: Tree.Item
components.description: A role="treeitem" list item, named by its Tree.Label. With a Tree.Group inside, it opens and closes, and aria-expanded says which.

props.name: value
props.description: Names the item for selection and for expanded. Unique in the tree.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Can't be selected. Still takes focus, so a screen reader announces it as unavailable, and still opens and closes.

props.name: children
props.description: A Tree.Label, then a Tree.Group for a branch.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the item.

components.description: The item's row and its name. Draws the chevron, from GlyphsProvider when one is set. A click selects the item and opens or closes a branch.

props.name: children
props.description: The item text, with an optional Tree.Icon before it.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the row.

components.name: Tree.Root
components.description: A role="tree" list with one tab stop. Up and Down move between the items shown, Right and Left open, close and move in and out, Home and End go to the ends, and typing finds an item.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected item. null selects none. Pass with onValueChange.

props.description: Fires with the item a click, Enter or Space selects. A tree given none of value, defaultValue and onValueChange has no selection.

props.description: Fires with the open items after an item opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: Tree.Item children.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the tree.

components.name: useAnnouncer
components.description: Takes no arguments and returns announce(message, options?), which reads message to screen readers through visually hidden live regions shared by the whole document; while a modal in the Todae modal stack is open, the one inside the modal in front. The props below are announce arguments.

props.name: message
props.description: Text to read. The same message twice is read twice. An empty string clears the region.

props.name: politeness
props.description: Options field. polite waits for the screen reader to finish; assertive interrupts it.

components.name: useAppearance
components.description: useAppearance() returns light or dark: the nearest ThemeProvider's appearance, with system resolved through prefers-color-scheme. It is light outside any ThemeProvider, and with system it is light on the server and while hydrating.

components.name: useChipField
components.description: Optional state helper. Field.ChipInput stays fully controlled without it.

props.name: initialChips
props.description: Starting chips.

props.name: initialInputValue
props.description: Starting input text.

props.name: dedupe
props.description: Skip commits that already exist.

props.name: transform
props.description: Normalize a commit. Null rejects. Default trims and rejects empty.

components.name: useChipList
components.description: Returns { listRef, measureRef, visible, hidden, measured }. visible is a prefix of chips. hidden is the +N count, capped at chips.length; 0 when maxRows is unset. measured is false on the server and before the first layout pass. Put listRef on the wrapping list (its width and gap drive the fold). The measure row on measureRef must be inert and aria-hidden and contain every chip, then a "…" probe chip, then a Chip.Root holding +{chips.length || 1}.

props.name: chips
props.description: Chip labels, in order. visible is always a prefix.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Fold chips that do not fit into +N. Unset shows every chip.

props.name: reserveWidth
props.description: Element whose computed min-width stays free on the last line. A ref so density changes stay current.

components.name: useClipboard
components.description: useClipboard(options?) returns { copy, status, text, reset }. copy(text) writes text with navigator.clipboard.writeText and resolves to whether it was copied. Once the latest copy settles, status is "copied" or "failed" and text is the text that copy was for, until resetAfter passes. The outcome of the latest copy is announced through useAnnouncer. There is no execCommand fallback.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before status returns to "idle". false keeps it until the next copy or reset().

props.name: copiedMessage
props.description: Read to screen readers after a copy. Default is the copied string from StringsProvider. An empty string reads nothing.

props.name: failedMessage
props.description: Read to screen readers, assertively, when a copy fails. Default is the copyFailed string from StringsProvider. An empty string reads nothing.

components.name: useCombobox
components.description: Headless combobox state. Spread getters onto Field, Button, Popover, BottomSheet, Dialog, and OptionList. No Combobox chrome.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single uses TextInput. Multiple uses ChipInput.

props.name: options
props.description: Sync options. Ignored when loadOptions is set.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async options. Stale responses are discarded. An inline function is fine; it is read at call time.

props.name: loadKey
props.description: Reloads options when it changes. Use it when loadOptions depends on state outside the query, such as a category.

props.name: presentation
props.description: auto uses useSheetPresentation. dialog is for Dialog.Root, through getDialogProps.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Show a create row when the query has no case-insensitive label match. With loadOptions, the row waits until the load for that query settles.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Null for empty single. Array for multiple.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled filter text.

components.name: useControlledState
components.description: useControlledState(controlled, defaultValue) returns [value, setValue]. While controlled is not undefined it is the value and setValue does nothing; otherwise setValue stores the next value. It never calls a change callback.

props.name: controlled
props.description: The value prop. undefined means uncontrolled, so use null for an empty controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Read on the first render only.

components.name: useControlledValue
components.description: useControlledValue(controlled, defaultValue, onChange) returns [value, change]. change(next, ...args) skips a value equal to the one from the last render (Object.is), stores it when uncontrolled, then calls onChange(next, ...args).

props.name: controlled
props.description: The value prop. undefined means uncontrolled, so use null for an empty controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Read on the first render only.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with each new value and any extra arguments, such as a reason, controlled or not.

components.name: useDensity
components.description: useDensity() returns the nearest DensityProvider's density, or comfortable outside one.

components.name: useDropzone
components.description: Returns { dragging, getRootProps, getInputProps }. Spread getInputProps on a native <input type="file"> and getRootProps on the drop target, usually the label around it, so a click and the keyboard open the file picker natively. Dropped folders are skipped. The picker applies accept and the hook checks dropped and pasted files against it. With paste, files pasted while focus is inside the root are taken too, unless the paste also carries plain text. Files from a drop, a paste or a pick are checked against maxSize, minSize and the file count, then passed to onFiles. In the browser, the input keeps only the accepted files, so a native form submits them. dragging, and data-dragging on the root, are set while files are dragged over the root.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types to take, in the input's accept syntax: '.pdf', 'image/*', 'application/json', comma separated. The picker applies it; the hook checks dropped and pasted files against it.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take more than one file.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files to take when multiple is set. Files past it are rejected as 'too-many'.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file size in bytes.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Smallest file size in bytes.

props.name: paste
props.description: Also take files pasted while focus is inside the root, such as a screenshot pasted into a textarea there. A paste that also carries plain text is left to the browser.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn off the input, drops and pastes.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called with the files that passed and the files that did not, after a drop, a paste or a pick.

components.name: useField
components.description: Joins a custom control to the nearest Field.Root. Spread getControlProps on the control. For a control that is not a native form element, render an input with getValueInputProps({ type, value, name, required, min, max, step, bound }, control) beside it, passing the props getControlProps returned: a hidden native input that submits the value under the field's name and that the browser validates, so required, min and max block a submit and Form.Root shows them and moves focus to the control. It follows the control's disabled and form, and takes no name when that control has one. getValueInputProps takes a type of text, number, date, time or datetime-local, the value in that type's format, and a bound that gives a min or max as the field shows it. Call notifyValueChange when a person changes the value in a way that fires no change event, such as a pick: it hides the field's server error and counts the field as edited. useField() takes no arguments.

components.name: useGlyphs
components.description: useGlyphs() returns the glyphs in effect: the nearest GlyphsProvider's, merged over its parents'. An unset or null key means Todae's own glyph.

components.name: useHighlight
components.description: Returns { ref, matches }. Put ref on the element to search. matches holds a live Range per match of query, in document order, and is empty on the server. Ranges paint through CSS.highlights under name, so nothing is added to the DOM; style them with ::highlight(name). The hook searches again when text or elements under ref change.

props.name: name
props.description: Name to style with ::highlight(name). Give each hook its own name.

props.name: query
props.description: Text to find inside the element on ref. A list matches any of its terms; empty strings are skipped.

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Match letter case exactly.

props.name: ranges
props.description: More ranges to paint, such as the current match. They need no ref and are not added to matches.

props.name: priority
props.description: Which highlight paints on top where two overlap. Higher wins.

props.name: type
props.description: Highlight type, for spelling and grammar marks.

components.name: useHotkey
components.description: useHotkey(hotkey, handler, options). Listens for keydown on the document and runs handler when a key matches hotkey, after preventing its default. It skips keys something else already prevented, keys pressed while an IME composes, held keys, and, in a text field, every key except a function key or a chord with Meta, or with Control but not Alt.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: A key with its modifiers, such as "Control+K", "Alt+T" or "F8". Modifiers must match exactly. A list matches any of them. One with a modifier name it does not know is off.

props.name: handler
props.description: Runs on a match. An inline function is fine; the latest one is read at key time.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Listen only while true. Pass it in the options object.

components.name: useMentions
components.description: Mentions and slash commands in a Field.Textarea. A trigger character at the start of a word opens a suggestion list at that word; a pick replaces the word with the token text through the textarea's own editing, so undo works. Committed tokens are ranges of the text that move with edits, drawn behind the text through Field.Textarea's highlights. Spread getters onto Field.Textarea, Popover and OptionList.

props.name: triggers
props.description: One entry per trigger character, such as { char: "@", options } or { char: "/", position: "start", loadOptions }. Each takes options or loadOptions, filter, text for what a pick inserts, and label for the list's name.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled draft: the text and its tokens, { start, end, char, value, text } ranges of it. A token that does not hold its text is left out. Set both to load or clear a draft.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting draft when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next text and its tokens together on every edit, including a pick. The tokens move with the edit, and a pick adds one.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The textarea's maxLength. A pick whose text would not fit is disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the list closed.

props.name: id
props.description: Base for the listbox id.

components.name: useModalLayer
components.description: useModalLayer(ref, open). Puts a modal <dialog> of your own in Todae's modal stack once open is true and it is shown with showModal(), until close(). Toast.Region moves its toasts into the modal in front. Dialog and BottomSheet join the stack by themselves.

props.name: ref
props.description: The <dialog>. Render it in the component that calls the hook, which reads the ref each time that component renders.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog may be shown. It joins once this is true and it is shown with showModal(), and stays until close().

components.name: usePopover
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getPopoverProps onto Popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on toggle or dismiss. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Sets CSS anchor-name on this element and excludes it from outside press.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Focus this element when the popover opens.

props.name: restoreFocusRef
props.description: Return focus here when the popover closes.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False skips toggle, dismiss, and focus moves.

props.name: haspopup
props.description: aria-haspopup on the trigger. Use "listbox" for an OptionList in a role-less popover.

props.name: id
props.description: Popover id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: useRovingFocus
components.description: One tab stop for a composite. Spread getContainerProps on the group and getItemProps(value) on each item.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move focus. Left and Right swap in a right-to-left container.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last item to the first and back.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Typing focuses the next item whose text starts with the typed characters.

props.name: tabStop
props.description: Keep one item tabbable. False when focus only enters from code, as in a menu: every item gets tabIndex -1.

props.name: findItems
props.description: Finds the items, enabled or not, instead of getItemProps. Such items have no value, so no tab stop is kept: the hook only moves focus.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Controlled tab stop. Falls back to the first enabled item when null, disabled or missing.

props.name: defaultActiveValue
props.description: Initial tab stop when uncontrolled.

props.name: onActiveValueChange
props.description: Fires when an item other than activeValue takes focus, including a fallback tab stop, so a controlled owner can pin it.

props.name: tree
props.description: Tree view keys. Up and Down skip items inside an item with aria-expanded="false" and do not wrap. Right opens a closed item or moves into an open one; Left closes an open item or moves to its parent. orientation and loop are ignored.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: In tree mode, fires when Right asks to open a closed item or Left asks to close an open one.

components.name: useSelection
components.description: useSelection(options) returns { value, isSelected, state, toggle, toggleAll, clear, getCheckboxProps, getSelectAllProps }. value is the selected keys in the order they were selected. state is "none", "some" or "all" over the enabled keys in keys, and "none" when there are none. getCheckboxProps(key, props?) returns { checked, disabled, onChange } and getSelectAllProps(props?) returns { checked, indeterminate, disabled, onChange }, to spread on Checkbox.Root. Shift held on a checkbox sets every enabled key between the last toggled key and it to its new state.

props.name: keys
props.description: The keys that can be selected now, in display order, such as the rows on the current page. Selected keys outside this list, such as those on other pages, are kept. K is a string or a number.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys that cannot be selected: ranges and select all skip them, and their checkbox is disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection, in the order keys were selected. Defined means controlled. A change you haven't passed back by the render that follows it, such as one you pass back after a fetch or in a transition that commits later, is forgotten, and the next change builds on the value you passed.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new selection after it changes.

components.name: useSheetPresentation
components.description: Coarse pointer or narrow width selects sheet. SSR and first paint are popover. isSheet mirrors presentation.

props.name: narrowWidth
props.description: Viewport width that starts the narrow media query. Media is max-width: n - 1.

props.name: coarseQuery
props.description: matchMedia query treated as coarse pointer.

props.name: forced
props.description: Skip media when popover or sheet. auto uses coarse OR narrow.

components.name: useStrings
components.description: useStrings() returns the strings in effect: the nearest StringsProvider's, merged over its parents', else English. Use it in your own components for text Todae's strings cover.

components.name: useTooltip
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getTooltipProps onto Tooltip. Interactive is a non-modal tip dialog.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Use the non-modal tip dialog. Links only. Never role=tooltip.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires after a commit. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: showDelay
props.description: Hover show delay in milliseconds. Without it, the tooltip.delay.show token as the trigger computes it. Focus shows at once.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Hide delay in milliseconds. Without it, the tooltip.delay.hide token as the trigger computes it.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False resets intent and commits close.

props.name: id
props.description: Tooltip id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: VisuallyHidden.Root
components.description: Hides content on screen and keeps it for assistive technology. A span with no role; takes native span attributes.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Shows the content again while focus is on it or inside it, for a skip link.

props.name: children
props.description: Text for assistive technology, or a focusable element such as a skip link.
